office_does: A Spokane County District Court judge, elected countywide for four years, hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic and civil cases, small claims and protection orders; the main discretion is in pretrial matters, plea and sentencing decisions and therapeutic-court supervision.
race_blurb: Open seat: incumbent Patti Connolly Walker is not running and endorses Nicholas Ulrich, an Attorney General's Office section chief and pro tem judge. Ulrich faces Michael Addams, Cheney's city prosecutor, a pro tem judicial officer and an Air Force veteran. The Spokane County Bar panel rated Ulrich Exceptionally Well Qualified and Addams Qualified; fundraising is close.

candidates.summary: Spokane-born section chief in the Washington Attorney General's Office Torts Division and a pro tem judge in Spokane County courts since 2021, after a Court of Appeals clerkship and work as a public defender and in private practice.
highlights: Section chief, Torts Division, Washington Attorney General's Office; former Court of Appeals Division III law clerk [S1][S3]
Pro tem judge or commissioner in Airway Heights, District and Superior courts since 2021 [S3]
Says a judge must "follow the law wherever it leads and not be swayed by personal preferences" [S2]
Rated Exceptionally Well Qualified by the Spokane County Bar Association panel (2026) [S6]
Endorsed by retiring Judge Patti Connolly Walker, Prosecutor Preston McCollam and the Spokane Police Guild [S4]

judicial.basis: States a restraint-oriented approach: follow the law wherever it leads, not personal preferences, beliefs or partisan views.

experience.basis: Not an incumbent, but runs as 'the most experienced candidate' on a clerkship, decade of litigation and five years of pro tem service, endorsed by the retiring incumbent and most of the local bench.

candidates.summary: City of Cheney prosecutor and owner of Addams & Associates who serves as a pro tem commissioner and judge in Spokane County courts; 24-year Air Force and Air National Guard veteran and EWU law and ethics instructor.
highlights: Municipal prosecutor for Cheney and EWU; former director of a statewide prosecutors' association program [S3][S5]
Superior Court commissioner pro tem since 2021, District Court judge pro tem since 2025 [S5]
Priorities: accountability to reduce repeat offenses, plus therapeutic courts that address addiction and mental health [S2]
Rated Qualified by the Spokane County Bar Association panel (2026) [S6]
Endorsed by Rep. Suzanne Schmidt, three District Court judges and many prosecutors [S4]

safety.basis: Prosecution formation and prosecutor-heavy endorsements; leads with accountability and reducing repeat offenses while also backing therapeutic courts; no bail position.

experience.basis: Not an incumbent, but runs on more than a decade of legal practice, prosecution and pro tem judicial service.
